title: Årsregnskabsloven (Danish Financial Statements Act), § 99 a: redegørelse for samfundsansvar, since 2024 bæredygtighedsrapportering
citation: Årsregnskabsloven, LBK nr 402 af 23/03/2026, § 99 a, inserted by Lov nr. 1403 af 27. december 2008, rewritten by Lov nr. 480 af 22. maj 2024
evidence: Lov nr. 1403 af 27. december 2008 (the act that inserted § 99 a): "Loven træder i kraft den 1. januar 2009 og har virkning for regnskabsår, der begynder den 1. januar 2009 eller senere." Opened https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2008/1403/xml on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is § 99 a only (all its subsections), cut from each lovbekendtgørelse (LBK) of the Act by the paragraph label "§ 99 a."; 6 records: LBK 395/2009, 1253/2013, 1580/2015, 838/2019, 1035/2024, 402/2026 (in_force is the LBK signing date; an LBK has no commencement clause). LBK 323/2011, 1441/2022 and 1057/2024 carry the same § 99 a text as the version before them and are not stored. LBK 647/2006 is served without XML text and predates § 99 a (inserted by Lov 1403/2008). The text change that took effect on 2024-06-01 (Lov 480/2024) first appears in LBK 1035/2024, so no LBK between 2022-11-14 and 2024-08-27 shows it; see dk-lov-480-2024. The timing provisions (§ 99 b, § 107 e and the postponement by Lov 1636/2025) are not in the record. Language: Danish only, the only official language. English: No government English found for the Danish Financial Statements Act: looked for on 2026-11-02 in a web search for an Erhvervsstyrelsen translation (only law-firm and audit-firm material, which is never stored) and on erhvervsstyrelsen.dk (the pages tried answer 404 or hold Danish guidance only); Retsinformation states it holds no translations.

title: Lov nr. 480 af 22. maj 2024 om ændring af årsregnskabsloven, revisorloven og forskellige andre love (CSRD transposition)
citation: Lov nr. 480 af 22. maj 2024 (Lovtidende A), implementing Directive (EU) 2022/2464 and Delegated Directive (EU) 2023/2775
evidence: Lov 480/2024, ikrafttrædelsesbestemmelsen: "Stk. 1. Loven træder i kraft den 1. juni 2024, jf. dog stk. 2 og 3." Stk. 2: § 2, nr. 33 on 1 January 2026; stk. 3: § 1, nr. 23 on 6 January 2030. Opened https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2024/480/xml on 2026-11-02.
notes: Whole act as published (the amendments to årsregnskabsloven in § 1, revisorloven in § 2 and other laws). Later reporting dates were postponed by Lov 1636/2025 (dk-lov-1636-2025). Language: Danish only. English: the Ministry of Business has no translation of this act that was found; looked for in the web search for Erhvervsstyrelsen translations on 2026-11-02 and via Retsinformation, which holds none.

title: Lov nr. 1636 af 16. december 2025 om ændring af årsregnskabsloven, lov om finansiel virksomhed, lov om forsikringsvirksomhed m.v. (udskydelse af pligten til rapportering om bæredygtighed)
evidence: Lov 1636/2025: "Stk. 1. Loven træder i kraft den 31. december 2025, jf. dog stk. 2." Stk. 2: "Erhvervsministeren fastsætter tidspunktet for ikrafttrædelse af § 1, nr. 3." Opened https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/1636/xml on 2026-11-02.
notes: Whole act as published. Retsinformation marks it Historic (amending act). No ministerial order fixing the date for § 1, nr. 3 was found, so that provision may not yet have commenced; the record is dated 2025-12-31 for the rest. BEK 328/2026 (dk-bek-328-2026) and BEK 1700/2025 (dk-bek-1700-2025) refer to the postponement. Language: Danish only. English: none found (web search and Retsinformation, 2026-11-02).

title: Lov om klima (Klimaloven)
citation: Lov nr. 965 af 26. juni 2020 om klima, as consolidated in LBK nr 2580 af 13/12/2021 (incorporating Lov nr. 2387 af 14/12/2021)
evidence: Lov 965/2020 § 13: "Loven træder i kraft dagen efter bekendtgørelsen i Lovtidende." Published in Lovtidende A on 27 June 2020 (Retsinformation metadata Offentliggørelsesdato 27/06/2020, ELI date_publication 27-06-2020), so in force 2020-06-28. Opened https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/965/xml on 2026-11-02.
notes: Two records: the act as published (2020-06-28) and LBK 2580/2021 (in_force is the LBK signing date). Retsinformation lists Lov 2387/2021 (indicative 2025 target) as incorporated in the LBK. No later amending act was found on Retsinformation (searches for "ændring af lov om klima" return only Lov 2387/2021; the 2024 bill on new 2045 and 2050 targets, 2024/1 LSF 33, appears only as a bill). English: the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities publishes an English PDF of Act No 965 of 2020 that calls itself an unofficial translation (https://en.kefm.dk/Media/1/B/Climate%20Act_Denmark%20-%20WEBTILG%c3%86NGELIG-A.pdf); its row DK-KEFM-TRANSLATION is permission requested (no reuse terms found on en.kefm.dk), so it is not stored and not in source_row. Language: Danish only.

title: Lov om CO2-kvoter (CO2-kvoteloven)
citation: Lov nr. 1095 af 28. november 2012; LBK 1605/2016, 62/2021, 536/2022; replaced by Lov nr. 1767 af 28. december 2023 om CO2-kvoter
evidence: Lov 1095/2012 § 38: "Loven træder i kraft den 1. januar 2013, jf. dog stk. 2." Stk. 2: § 5 and § 31 in force the day after publication. Opened https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2012/1095/xml on 2026-11-02.
notes: 5 records: Lov 1095/2012 as published (2013-01-01), LBK 1605/2016, LBK 62/2021, LBK 536/2022 (in_force is the LBK signing date) and Lov 1767/2023 (in force 2024-01-01 per its § 27 "Loven træder i kraft den 1. januar 2024", a new act that replaces the 2012 act). Lov 468/2025 (Energiklagenævnet) amends Lov 1767/2023 and is not stored. Language: Danish only. English: none found on Retsinformation (holds none) or by web search on 2026-11-02.

title: Markedsføringsloven (Marketing Practices Act), §§ 5, 6 and 13: misleading and aggressive practices, umbrella for environmental claims
citation: Lov nr. 426 af 3. maj 2017 om markedsføring; LBK nr 866 af 15/06/2022; LBK nr 1420 af 02/12/2024
evidence: Lov 426/2017 § 40: "Loven træder i kraft den 1. juli 2017." Opened https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2017/426/xml on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is §§ 5, 6 and 13 only, cut by paragraph label from each version. 2 records: Lov 426/2017 as published and LBK 866/2022 (in_force is the LBK signing date). LBK 1420/2024 has the same text of these sections as LBK 866/2022 and is not stored. Lov 558/2025 and Lov 1322/2025 amend the act and are not consolidated on Retsinformation. English: the Danish Competition and Consumer Authority publishes an English PDF of Act No 426 of 3 May 2017 (https://kfst.dk/media/49887/mfl-english.pdf); its row DK-KFST-TRANSLATION is permission requested, and it reflects the 2017 state, so it is not stored and not in source_row. A web search on 2026-11-02 for an English version at forbrugerombudsmanden.dk found price-information guidelines but no translation of the Act. Language: Danish only.
